external_collaboration.evidence_quote: Elevate your academic journey with the IU Oxford Certificate Programme, an exclusive, intensive study abroad summer experience at Worcester College, University of Oxford. The one- to two-week programme is open to students with an interest in business management and computer science or AI-related programmes.

internal_collaboration.evidence_quote: Our headquarters are located in Erfurt (Thuringia, Germany) and the campuses in Cologne, Bad Honnef and Berlin are branches. All programmes are accredited in the federal state of Thuringia by the German Council of Science and Humanities and the German Accreditation Council (System & Programme Accreditation), and have been awarded "FIBAA Premium" status by FIBAA and many more.
